long_biography.plain_text:
Kamışlı entered business in 1986 at Exsa before moving through marketing, administration and general-management assignments in the Sabancı cement companies. He eventually became head of the conglomerate's cement group and chaired major producers Akçansa and Çimsa, giving him operating responsibility across manufacturing, sales and corporate governance.

In 2008, Kamışlı moved to the board of Esas, a family investment firm active across private equity, property, venture capital and public markets. His responsibilities later included leadership of Medline Healthcare and Esas's real-estate arm. The shift broadened his work from one industrial sector to a portfolio spanning healthcare, property and logistics, while retaining the board-level discipline developed during his cement career.
